verdict.rationale: Fathom's REST API, webhooks, and SDKs expose AI-generated action items and meeting data (fathom-docs-22, fathom-docs-45, fathom-docs-28) that an agent could use to push items into a project tracker, and the MCP server lets AI assistants query meeting data directly. However there is no evidence of a native/pre-built Linear, Jira, or Asana integration — only CRM field sync is mentioned as a native automation. Missing for 10: documented native connectors to Linear/Jira/Asana, and any example/template showing action items being filed into a project tracker end-to-end.
